% ============================================================================
% Pascal triangle of the Dyson series,  H_I = e (J_e + J_mu),  process e mu -> e mu
%
%   row n          : order in e
%   cell (n_e,n_mu): n_e vertices on the electron line, n_mu on the muon line
%   number         : binomial coefficient C(n, n_mu)
%   picture        : the diagram(s) generated by that term
%
% Page = PowerPoint widescreen (13.333in x 7.5in).  Compile with pdflatex or lualatex.
% Tweaks:  \tagsfalse hides the small (n_e,n_mu) tags;
%          \dsc (diagram size) and \cw (cell width) are set per row near the end.
% ============================================================================
\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.markings,decorations.pathmorphing,arrows.meta}
\usepackage[paperwidth=338.67mm,paperheight=190.5mm,
            left=14mm,right=5mm,top=4mm,bottom=4mm]{geometry}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}

\definecolor{ecol}{HTML}{1F4E9C}   % electron line
\definecolor{mcol}{HTML}{C0392B}   % muon line

\newif\iftags \tagstrue            % show the (n_e,n_mu) tag above each number

% ------------------------------------------------------------------ TikZ styles
\tikzset{
  ferm/.style={line width=1.1pt,
    decoration={markings,
      mark=at position 0.58 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.35mm]}}},
    postaction={decorate}},
  floop/.style={line width=1.1pt,
    decoration={markings,
      mark=at position 0.125 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.35mm]}},
      mark=at position 0.625 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.35mm]}}},
    postaction={decorate}},
  fermlate/.style={line width=1.1pt,        % arrow placed after the crossing point
    decoration={markings,
      mark=at position 0.84 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.35mm]}}},
    postaction={decorate}},
  ph/.style={line width=0.9pt,decorate,
    decoration={snake,amplitude=1.2pt,segment length=4.6pt}},
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------------ diagram macros
% Frame: 2.4 wide, 2 high, time runs left -> right, top line y=2, bottom line y=0.
% Optional first argument = extra TikZ options (yscale=-1 puts the decorated line at the bottom).
\newcommand{\dsc}{0.8}
\newcommand{\dgm}[2][]{\ensuremath{\vcenter{\hbox{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}[scale=\dsc,#1]#2\end{tikzpicture}}}}}
\newcommand{\fl}[3]{\draw[ferm,color=#1] (#2) -- (#3);}   % fermion segment
\newcommand{\flx}[3]{\draw[fermlate,color=#1] (#2) -- (#3);} % fermion segment, late arrow
\newcommand{\wv}[2]{\draw[ph] (#1) -- (#2);}               % photon segment
\newcommand{\vx}[1]{\fill (#1) circle (1.2pt);}            % vertex dot

% no interaction (n=0): two free lines
\newcommand{\dI}[2]{\dgm{\fl{#1}{0,1.2}{2.4,1.2}\fl{#2}{0,0.3}{2.4,0.3}}}

% single vertex with one external photon (n=1)
\newcommand{\dV}[1]{\dgm{\fl{#1}{0,0}{1.2,0}\fl{#1}{1.2,0}{2.4,0}\wv{1.2,0}{1.2,1.8}\vx{1.2,0}}}

% one-photon exchange, t channel:  #1 top line, #2 bottom line
\newcommand{\dT}[2]{\dgm{%
  \fl{#1}{0,2}{1.2,2}\fl{#1}{1.2,2}{2.4,2}%
  \fl{#2}{0,0}{1.2,0}\fl{#2}{1.2,0}{2.4,0}%
  \wv{1.2,2}{1.2,0}\vx{1.2,2}\vx{1.2,0}}}

% one-photon exchange, u channel (identical particles: outgoing legs swapped)
\newcommand{\dU}[2]{\dgm{%
  \fl{#1}{0,2}{0.9,2}\flx{#1}{0.9,2}{2.4,0}%
  \fl{#2}{0,0}{0.9,0}\flx{#2}{0.9,0}{2.4,2}%
  \wv{0.9,2}{0.9,0}\vx{0.9,2}\vx{0.9,0}}}

% exchange + one external photon radiated from the top line (n=3)
% A: radiated before the exchange      B: radiated after the exchange
\newcommand{\dBa}[3][]{\dgm[#1]{%
  \fl{#2}{0,2}{0.65,2}\fl{#2}{0.65,2}{1.55,2}\fl{#2}{1.55,2}{2.4,2}%
  \fl{#3}{0,0}{1.55,0}\fl{#3}{1.55,0}{2.4,0}%
  \wv{1.55,2}{1.55,0}\wv{0.65,2}{0.65,2.9}\vx{0.65,2}\vx{1.55,2}\vx{1.55,0}}}
\newcommand{\dBb}[3][]{\dgm[#1]{%
  \fl{#2}{0,2}{0.85,2}\fl{#2}{0.85,2}{1.75,2}\fl{#2}{1.75,2}{2.4,2}%
  \fl{#3}{0,0}{0.85,0}\fl{#3}{0.85,0}{2.4,0}%
  \wv{0.85,2}{0.85,0}\wv{1.75,2}{1.75,2.9}\vx{0.85,2}\vx{0.85,0}\vx{1.75,2}}}
% crossed (u-channel) exchange, photon radiated from the incoming top line
% (identical particles only: the outgoing legs are swapped)
\newcommand{\dUr}[2]{\dgm{%
  \fl{#1}{0,2}{0.45,2}\fl{#1}{0.45,2}{1.15,2}\flx{#1}{1.15,2}{2.4,0}%
  \fl{#2}{0,0}{1.15,0}\flx{#2}{1.15,0}{2.4,2}%
  \wv{1.15,2}{1.15,0}\wv{0.45,2}{0.45,2.9}\vx{0.45,2}\vx{1.15,2}\vx{1.15,0}}}

% one-loop pieces on the top line (#2), other line #3
\newcommand{\dVc}[3][]{\dgm[#1]{%                         vertex correction
  \fl{#2}{0,2}{0.5,2}\fl{#2}{0.5,2}{1.2,1}\fl{#2}{1.2,1}{1.9,2}\fl{#2}{1.9,2}{2.4,2}%
  \wv{0.5,2}{1.9,2}\wv{1.2,1}{1.2,0}%
  \fl{#3}{0,0}{1.2,0}\fl{#3}{1.2,0}{2.4,0}%
  \vx{0.5,2}\vx{1.9,2}\vx{1.2,1}\vx{1.2,0}}}
\newcommand{\dSi}[3][]{\dgm[#1]{%                         self-energy, incoming leg
  \fl{#2}{0,2}{0.35,2}\fl{#2}{0.35,2}{1.05,2}\fl{#2}{1.05,2}{1.7,2}\fl{#2}{1.7,2}{2.4,2}%
  \draw[ph] (0.35,2) arc[start angle=180,end angle=0,x radius=0.35,y radius=0.45];%
  \wv{1.7,2}{1.7,0}%
  \fl{#3}{0,0}{1.7,0}\fl{#3}{1.7,0}{2.4,0}%
  \vx{0.35,2}\vx{1.05,2}\vx{1.7,2}\vx{1.7,0}}}
\newcommand{\dSo}[3][]{\dgm[#1]{%                         self-energy, outgoing leg
  \fl{#2}{0,2}{0.7,2}\fl{#2}{0.7,2}{1.35,2}\fl{#2}{1.35,2}{2.05,2}\fl{#2}{2.05,2}{2.4,2}%
  \draw[ph] (1.35,2) arc[start angle=180,end angle=0,x radius=0.35,y radius=0.45];%
  \wv{0.7,2}{0.7,0}%
  \fl{#3}{0,0}{0.7,0}\fl{#3}{0.7,0}{2.4,0}%
  \vx{0.7,2}\vx{1.35,2}\vx{2.05,2}\vx{0.7,0}}}
\newcommand{\dVp}[4][]{\dgm[#1]{%                         vacuum polarisation: top, bottom, loop
  \fl{#2}{0,2}{1.2,2}\fl{#2}{1.2,2}{2.4,2}%
  \fl{#3}{0,0}{1.2,0}\fl{#3}{1.2,0}{2.4,0}%
  \wv{1.2,2}{1.2,1.4}\wv{1.2,0.6}{1.2,0}%
  \draw[floop,color=#4] (1.2,1) circle (0.4);%
  \vx{1.2,2}\vx{1.2,1.4}\vx{1.2,0.6}\vx{1.2,0}}}

% two-photon exchange
\newcommand{\dBx}[2]{\dgm{%                               box
  \fl{#1}{0,2}{0.65,2}\fl{#1}{0.65,2}{1.75,2}\fl{#1}{1.75,2}{2.4,2}%
  \fl{#2}{0,0}{0.65,0}\fl{#2}{0.65,0}{1.75,0}\fl{#2}{1.75,0}{2.4,0}%
  \wv{0.65,2}{0.65,0}\wv{1.75,2}{1.75,0}%
  \vx{0.65,2}\vx{1.75,2}\vx{0.65,0}\vx{1.75,0}}}
\newcommand{\dXb}[2]{\dgm{%                               crossed box
  \fl{#1}{0,2}{0.65,2}\fl{#1}{0.65,2}{1.75,2}\fl{#1}{1.75,2}{2.4,2}%
  \fl{#2}{0,0}{0.65,0}\fl{#2}{0.65,0}{1.75,0}\fl{#2}{1.75,0}{2.4,0}%
  \wv{0.65,2}{1.75,0}\wv{1.75,2}{0.65,0}%
  \vx{0.65,2}\vx{1.75,2}\vx{0.65,0}\vx{1.75,0}}}

% ------------------------------------------------------------------ layout macros
\newlength{\cw}                                          % cell width (set per row)
\newcommand{\opfont}{\fontsize{18}{20}\selectfont}
\newcommand{\pl}{\hspace{0.8mm}\hbox{\opfont$+$}\hspace{0.8mm}}
\newcommand{\mn}{\hspace{0.8mm}\hbox{\opfont$-$}\hspace{0.8mm}}
\newcommand{\cd}{\hbox{\opfont$\cdots$}}
% Square brackets around a sum of diagrams.  A negative \delimitershortfall makes the brackets
% taller than their content (here by 3.5mm in total) and the \hspace pads the sides, so the
% brackets do not touch the diagrams.  (The group must enclose the whole formula.)
\newcommand{\br}[1]{{\delimiterfactor=1000 \delimitershortfall=-3.5mm
  \ensuremath{\left[\vcenter{\hbox{\hspace{1.2mm}#1\hspace{1.2mm}}}\right]}}}
\newcommand{\coef}[1]{\hbox{\fontsize{28}{32}\selectfont\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\rowlab}[1]{{\fontsize{16}{18}\selectfont\color{black!55}$n{=}#1$}}

% Sums of diagrams laid out in two columns.  \vpl is a compact "+" between the rows
% (\arraystretch is reduced so the rows do not inherit the large strut of the cell font).
\newcommand{\vpl}{\raisebox{0pt}[3.8mm][0.55mm]{\hbox{\opfont$+$}}}
\newcommand{\grid}[4]{%                      2x2 sum
  \begingroup\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{0.2}%
  \begin{tabular}{@{}c@{\hspace{0.8mm}}c@{\hspace{0.8mm}}c@{}}
    #1 & \pl & #2 \\[0.4mm]
    \multicolumn{3}{c}{\vpl} \\[0.4mm]
    #3 & \pl & #4
  \end{tabular}\endgroup}
\newcommand{\gridF}[5]{%                     five diagrams followed by "+ ..."
  \begingroup\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{0.2}%
  \begin{tabular}{@{}c@{\hspace{0.8mm}}c@{\hspace{0.8mm}}c@{}}
    #1 & \pl & #2 \\[0.4mm]
    \multicolumn{3}{c}{\vpl} \\[0.4mm]
    #3 & \pl & #4 \\[0.4mm]
    \multicolumn{3}{c}{\vpl} \\[0.4mm]
    #5 & \pl & \cd
  \end{tabular}\endgroup}

% one cell:  #1 tag (n_e,n_mu), #2 coefficient, #3 picture(s).
% The equation is an unbreakable box; a warning is issued if it exceeds its slot.
\newcommand{\cell}[3]{%
  \setbox0\hbox{\fontsize{24}{28}\selectfont
     $\vcenter{\hbox{\coef{#2}}}\,\vcenter{\hbox{\opfont$\times$}}\,\vcenter{\hbox{#3}}$}%
  \ifdim\wd0>\cw
    \PackageWarning{pascal}{Cell (#1) is \the\dimexpr\wd0-\cw\relax\space too wide for its slot}%
  \fi
  \vbox{\offinterlineskip
    \hbox to \cw{\hss\iftags{\fontsize{11}{13}\selectfont\color{black!50}$(#1)$}\fi\hss}%
    \kern1.2mm
    \hbox to \cw{\hss\box0\hss}}}

% one row of the triangle:  #1 n, #2 height, #3 cells
\newcommand{\row}[3]{\parbox[c][#2][c]{\textwidth}{%
  \hbox to \textwidth{\llap{\rowlab{#1}\hspace{2mm}}\hfil #3\hfil}}}

% legend (top-left corner)
\newcommand{\legend}{{\fontsize{14}{17}\selectfont
  \begin{tabular}{@{}l@{\hspace{2.5mm}}l@{}}
    \tikz[baseline=-0.5ex]\draw[ferm,color=ecol] (0,0)--(10mm,0); & $e$ \\[1.2mm]
    \tikz[baseline=-0.5ex]\draw[ferm,color=mcol] (0,0)--(10mm,0); & $\mu$ \\[1.2mm]
    \tikz[baseline=-0.5ex]\draw[ph] (0,0)--(10mm,0); & $\gamma$ \\[2mm]
    \multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\color{black!55}$(n_e,n_\mu)$}
  \end{tabular}}}

% ============================================================================
\begin{document}

% ---- n = 0 --------------------------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\dsc}{1.2}\setlength{\cw}{80mm}
\row{0}{22mm}{\makebox[0.3\textwidth][l]{\legend}%
  \cell{0,0}{1}{\dI{ecol}{mcol}}%
  \makebox[0.3\textwidth]{}}\par\nointerlineskip

% ---- n = 1 --------------------------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\dsc}{1.1}\setlength{\cw}{85mm}
\row{1}{28mm}{%
  \cell{1,0}{1}{\dV{ecol}}%
  \cell{0,1}{1}{\dV{mcol}}}\par\nointerlineskip

% ---- n = 2 --------------------------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\dsc}{1.0}\setlength{\cw}{82mm}
\row{2}{32mm}{%
  \cell{2,0}{1}{\br{\dT{ecol}{ecol}\mn\dU{ecol}{ecol}}}%
  \cell{1,1}{2}{\dT{ecol}{mcol}}%
  \cell{0,2}{1}{\br{\dT{mcol}{mcol}\mn\dU{mcol}{mcol}}}}\par\nointerlineskip

% ---- n = 3 --------------------------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\dsc}{0.8}
\row{3}{36mm}{%
  \setlength{\cw}{80.6mm}%                       wider slots for the two edge cells
  \cell{3,0}{1}{\br{\dBa{ecol}{ecol}\pl\dUr{ecol}{ecol}\pl\cd}}\hspace{5mm}%
  \setlength{\cw}{68.5mm}%
  \cell{2,1}{3}{\br{\dBa{ecol}{mcol}\pl\dBb{ecol}{mcol}}}\hspace{5mm}%
  \cell{1,2}{3}{\br{\dBa[yscale=-1]{mcol}{ecol}\pl\dBb[yscale=-1]{mcol}{ecol}}}\hspace{5mm}%
  \setlength{\cw}{80.6mm}%
  \cell{0,3}{1}{\br{\dBa{mcol}{mcol}\pl\dUr{mcol}{mcol}\pl\cd}}}\par\nointerlineskip

% ---- n = 4 --------------------------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\dsc}{0.66}\setlength{\cw}{0.2\textwidth}
\row{4}{64mm}{%
  \cell{4,0}{1}{\br{\gridF{\dBx{ecol}{ecol}}{\dVc{ecol}{ecol}}%
                           {\dSi{ecol}{ecol}}{\dSo{ecol}{ecol}}{\dVp{ecol}{ecol}{ecol}}}}%
  \cell{3,1}{4}{\br{\grid{\dVc{ecol}{mcol}}{\dSi{ecol}{mcol}}%
                          {\dSo{ecol}{mcol}}{\dVp{ecol}{mcol}{ecol}}}}%
  \cell{2,2}{6}{\br{\dBx{ecol}{mcol}\pl\dXb{ecol}{mcol}}}%
  \cell{1,3}{4}{\br{\grid{\dVc[yscale=-1]{mcol}{ecol}}{\dSi[yscale=-1]{mcol}{ecol}}%
                          {\dSo[yscale=-1]{mcol}{ecol}}{\dVp{ecol}{mcol}{mcol}}}}%
  \cell{0,4}{1}{\br{\gridF{\dBx{mcol}{mcol}}{\dVc{mcol}{mcol}}%
                           {\dSi{mcol}{mcol}}{\dSo{mcol}{mcol}}{\dVp{mcol}{mcol}{mcol}}}}}\par

\end{document}
